Handover hints for tag checks
You can use this page

Tag checks at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

When a traveler arrives with a pet, start with the tag and keep the tone calm. The desk team should welcome every concern in a warm, professional way, because a small mismatch can slow the trip and add stress fast. Check the pet tag against the booking details, then look at the carrier label, the contact note, and any handover paper already on file. If anything looks off, pause and fix it before the pet moves on.

During routine desk work, keep the handover clean and simple. Confirm who is releasing the pet, who is receiving it, and whether the carrier is secure and ready. If the traveler seems worried, listen closely and pass the issue to a supervisor without delay. The whole point is to keep care steady from booking through pickup, with no gaps and no guesswork.

If a pet like Peanut is involved, stay extra careful with each label and note. A small check now can prevent a big problem later, and that matters to every traveler. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
